name: Camping 101: Herbalism
summary: Komin Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff can teach you to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. Herbalism skill opens the way to a useful aid for healers and spellcasters.

sections.title: A Candle for Camp
sections.body: A teacher in Thunder Bluff asks you to put your herbalism skill to use in learning a camp craft. The Incense Candle can lift the spirits of healers and spellcasters. You leave with the knowledge to make one, but testing it calls for a camp beyond the town and a campfire to go with it.

faq.answer: Komin Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff teaches you to craft an Incense Candle.

faq.q: What does herbalism have to do with camping?
faq.answer: Showing proficiency in herbalism lets you learn to craft an Incense Candle for your camp.

faq.q: What is an Incense Candle for?
faq.answer: An Incense Candle can boost the spirits of healers and spellcasters.

faq.q: Where can I try the candle?
faq.answer: You need to head into the wilderness to test it, since most folk do not care for camps in the center of town.

faq.q: Do I need anything else for camp?
faq.answer: A campfire is needed before you start your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make one.

angles.text: As a herbalist, your skill lets you learn to craft an Incense Candle for camp.
As a cook, you can teach the basics of making a campfire, which a camp needs.
